summary: A groovebox with up to six assignable tracks, combining synth engines, a drum machine bank, an acid line generator and a break slicer, built on JIANT's sequencer and project system. Public beta.
features: Eight synth engines incl. FM6, OberVave, FMINI-1, wavetable and SID-6581
31 drum kits plus the 55-preset Hortator MD bank; swap single drum sounds
Acid tracks with 303-style generate and mutate; one Break slicer per project
Euclid, Turing, Grids and other generators; 59 arrangement genres
Sidechain ducking; USB MIDI host for controllers; four projects, sections A-D
Web editor for patterns and loops; dense songs can exceed the CPU
